A Roman silver coin: denarius of Domitian (AD91-2). Obverse: Laureate bust right Obverse inscription: IMP CAES DOMIT AVG GERM P M TR P XI Reverse: Minerva standing left holding spear Reverse inscription: IMP XXI COS XV CENS PPP Die axis measurement: 6.00. Dimensions: diameter: 18.89mm; weight: 2.92g
